17:87.text: Except as a Mercy from your Lord. Verily His Grace unto you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)

17:88.text: Say: "If the mankind and the jinn were together to produce the like of this Qur’ân, they could not produce the like thereof, even if they helped one another."

17:89.text: And indeed We have fully explained to mankind, in this Qur’ân, every kind of similitude, but most of mankind refuse

17:90.text: And they say: "We shall not believe in you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
, until you cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us;

17:91.text: "Or you have a garden of date-palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth in their midst abundantly;

17:92.text: "Or you cause the heaven to fall upon us in pieces, as you have pretended, or you bring Allâh and the angels before

17:93.text: "Or you have a house of Zukhruf
, or you ascend up into the sky, and even then we will put no faith in your ascension until you bring down for us a Book that we would read." Say
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
[(Allâh) above all that evil they (polytheists) associate with Him]
! Am I anything but a man, sent as a Messenger?"

17:94.text: And nothing prevented men from believing when the guidance came to them, except that they said: "Has Allâh sent a man as

17:95.text: Say: "If there were on the earth, angels walking about in peace and security, We should certainly have sent down for them from the heaven an angel as a Messenger."

17:96.text: Say: "Sufficient is Allâh for a witness between me and you. Verily He is Ever the All-Knower, the All-Seer of His slaves."
